title: Paul's trumpet style and King Oliver's influence
summary: Paul's idol was King Oliver and he used mutes on early Rhythm Kings records.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: say, you're the only one I can think of that really would know much about Paul. Can you tell us anything else about this style of playing? Did he ever use mutes that you know much?

Oh yeah. Well, Paul always followed the Oliver tradition. He liked King Oliver. I know he told me that himself. Yeah, yeah, that was his idol. I talked to him. King Oliver, at least, was Paul's idol. And if you recall, Bill, King Oliver was a real mute man himself. I didn't know that Paul ever used mutes. Oh yeah, Paul, oh yeah, you can get the early Jeanettes and you can see he has that mute effect like King Oliver. I didn't remember much of that. Oh yeah, oh yeah, very, very, Paul used the mute all the time. Yeah, plenty of times. He followed the Oliver, he liked Oliver and in fact he tried to copy Oliver. That was a big job. Ain't nobody could do it, but he tried. He had a peculiar style. Yeah, he had his own style which was one of the tops too.
